jobs.title: Senior Dotnet Consultant
jobs.description:
SENIOR .NET / AWS ENGINEER – CAMUNDA
Contract: Until the end of 2026, with a possibility to extend
Rate: €50/hour
Location: Remote(Poland or Lithuania preffered)
Language: English

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET / AWS Engineer to join a mature and highly skilled engineering squad working on a modern, distributed banking solution.
The role focuses on building and maintaining high-criticality data pipelines and enterprise applications using .NET and AWS services. A key requirement is hands-on experience with Camunda and workflow/process orchestration.

What you’ll be doing
Design and develop robust enterprise applications using .NET
Build and maintain distributed solutions leveraging AWS services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions and DynamoDB
Work with Camunda for workflow and business process orchestration
Contribute to high-criticality data pipelines with a strong focus on scalability, reliability and performance
Develop CI/CD automation using GitHub Enterprise
Work with infrastructure as code using Terraform
Troubleshoot incidents, resolve bugs and continuously improve platform stability
Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects and business analysts
Contribute to documentation and technical improvements within a self-organizing Scrum team
Help build secure and reliable solutions for a modern banking environment

What we’re looking for
3–5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong experience with .NET
Hands-on experience with Camunda – required
Solid understanding of AWS, particularly services such as Lambda, S3, SQS, Step Functions and DynamoDB
Experience with GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD
Experience with Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks is a plus
Experience with Kafka or other message queue/event-streaming platforms is a plus
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Good spoken and written English

Contract details
€50/hour

Contract until 31 December 2026
Possibility to extend

Opportunity to work on a modern, high-impact banking platform

You will develop new functionalities, work with existing and legacy code, contribute to solution architecture, and collaborate with Developers, Testers, Analysts and the Product Owner in a Scrum environment.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Location: Remote (European Time Zone), once per month in the office in Cracow

Contract Type: B2B

About Us:

ETFBOOK is a Swiss SaaS company providing data, analytics, and custom solutions in the Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) space. Founded in 2020, we aim to make global ETF data accessible, actionable, and valuable for institutional participants, including ETF issuers, index providers, fund service providers, market makers, exchanges, and buy-side institutions.
We develop a platform which offers comprehensive insights through a user-friendly web application and robust APIs, covering areas such as product analysis, fund flow tracking, performance comparisons, and liquidity assessments.

About the role:

We are seeking a Full-Stack Software Developer with interest in Frontend development to join our fully remote team spread across Europe.
You’ll join a highly skilled technology team. This team develops and maintains a cutting-edge data analytics platform using most advanced technologies to support all core business functions. You’ll be a part of a collaborative team focused on the application development. This role offers the chance to make a visible impact in a dynamic, fast-evolving field.

Responsibilities:

Develops and maintains complex end-to-end features across the latest Angular and .NET.
Designs solutions covering front-end, backend, APIs, databases, and data processing.
Leads solution design and requirements analysis for major initiatives.
Ensures end-to-end performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
Reviews code across the stack and promotes engineering standards.
Troubleshoots complex cross-system issues and supports production stability.
Mentors junior and mid-level full-stack engineers.

Requirements:

8+ years of experience in web application development.
Strong expertise in latest Angular / TypeScript and the latest .NET/ C#.
Strong understanding of front-end, backend, API and database architecture.
Experience designing and delivering complex features end-to-end.
Experience with automated testing and deployment.
Strong understanding of application performance, scalability, and code quality.
Experience with Azure and AI-assisted development tools.
Good knowledge of Azure
Works independently and takes ownership of complex tasks.
Strong communication skills in English.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Able to work effectively with Product, Data and Technology teams.
Able to review code and provide technical guidance.
Able to mentor Junior and Mid-level engineers.
Commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

Nice to have:

Experience with data visualization.
Basics of UX/UI and ability to identify improvements.
Interest in financial markets, especially ETFs.
Experience with B2B SaaS products
Able to make and explain technical decisions.

What we offer:

100% remote work from anywhere within the European time zone.
Competitive B2B contract.
Exciting growth opportunities in a fast-paced startup.
Impactful work: help revolutionise ETF data market, currently fastest growing area of finance.
Have a real impact of developing products: your work will directly influence live projects, delivering measurable results in real-world applications.
Culture of innovation: collaborate with forward-thinking professionals in technology and finance where experimentation and creativity are encouraged.
Team- buildings events at least twice a year, hosted in various European locations.
